paras.en: Canada is the second largest country on earth—10 million square kilometres.
paras.zh: 加拿大是地球上第二大的國家——一千萬平方公里。

paras.en: Three oceans line Canada's frontiers: the Pacific Ocean in the west, the Atlantic Ocean in the east, and the Arctic Ocean to the north.
paras.zh: 三個大洋環繞加拿大的邊界：西邊是太平洋，東邊是大西洋，北邊是北冰洋。

paras.en: Along the southern edge of Canada lies the Canada-United States boundary.
paras.zh: 加拿大的南緣是加拿大與美國的邊界。

paras.en: Both Canada and the U.S.A. are committed to a safe, secure and efficient frontier.
paras.zh: 加拿大和美國都致力於維持一條安全、穩固而有效率的邊界。

paras.en: Canada includes many different geographical areas and five distinct regions: the Atlantic Provinces, Central Canada, the Prairie Provinces, the West Coast, and the Northern Territories.
paras.zh: 加拿大包含許多不同的地理區域，分為五個不同的區域：大西洋省份、中部加拿大、草原省份、西海岸，以及北方地區。

paras.en: Ottawa, located on the Ottawa River, was chosen as the capital in 1857 by Queen Victoria, the great-great-grandmother of Queen Elizabeth II.
paras.zh: 位於渥太華河畔的渥太華，在 1857 年由伊莉莎白二世女王的高祖母維多利亞女王選為首都。

paras.en: Today it is Canada's fourth largest metropolitan area.
paras.zh: 今天它是加拿大第四大都會區。

paras.en: The National Capital Region, 4,700 square kilometres surrounding Ottawa, preserves and enhances the area's built heritage and natural environment.
paras.zh: 環繞渥太華、面積 4,700 平方公里的國家首都區，保存並提升該地區的建築遺產和自然環境。

paras.en: Canada has ten provinces and three territories.
paras.zh: 加拿大有十個省和三個地區。

paras.en: Each province and territory has its own capital city.
paras.zh: 每個省和地區都有自己的首府。

paras.en: You should know the capital of your province or territory as well as that of Canada.
paras.zh: 你應該知道自己所在省或地區的首府，以及加拿大的首都。

paras.en: Atlantic Provinces: Newfoundland and Labrador, capital St. John's; Prince Edward Island, capital Charlottetown; Nova Scotia, capital Halifax; New Brunswick, capital Fredericton.
paras.zh: 大西洋省份：紐芬蘭與拉布拉多，首府聖約翰斯（St. John's）；愛德華王子島，首府夏洛特敦（Charlottetown）；新斯科細亞，首府哈利法克斯（Halifax）；新布藍瑞克，首府弗雷德里克頓（Fredericton）。

paras.en: Central Canada: Quebec, capital Québec City; Ontario, capital Toronto.
paras.zh: 中部加拿大：魁北克，首府魁北克市（Québec City）；安大略，首府多倫多（Toronto）。

paras.en: Prairie Provinces: Manitoba, capital Winnipeg; Saskatchewan, capital Regina; Alberta, capital Edmonton.
paras.zh: 草原省份：曼尼托巴，首府溫尼伯（Winnipeg）；薩克其萬，首府里賈納（Regina）；亞伯達，首府艾德蒙頓（Edmonton）。

paras.en: West Coast: British Columbia, capital Victoria.
paras.zh: 西海岸：卑詩省，首府維多利亞（Victoria）。

paras.en: North: Nunavut, capital Iqaluit; Northwest Territories, capital Yellowknife; Yukon Territory, capital Whitehorse.
paras.zh: 北方：努納福特，首府伊魁特（Iqaluit）；西北地區，首府黃刀鎮（Yellowknife）；育空地區，首府白馬市（Whitehorse）。

paras.en: Canada has a population of about 34 million people.
paras.zh: 加拿大的人口約三千四百萬。

paras.en: While the majority live in cities, Canadians also live in small towns, rural areas and everywhere in between.
paras.zh: 雖然大多數人住在城市，加拿大人也住在小鎮、鄉村，以及介於兩者之間的各種地方。

paras.en: Note: this is the 2021 edition's figure; Canada passed 40 million people in 2023.
paras.zh: 注意：這是 2021 年版的數字；加拿大人口在 2023 年已突破四千萬。

paras.en: Atlantic Canada's coasts and natural resources, including fishing, farming, forestry and mining, have made these provinces an important part of Canada's history and development.
paras.zh: 大西洋加拿大的海岸和自然資源——包括漁業、農業、林業和礦業——使這些省份成為加拿大歷史與發展的重要部分。

paras.en: The Atlantic Ocean brings cool winters and cool humid summers.
paras.zh: 大西洋帶來涼爽的冬天和涼爽潮濕的夏天。

paras.en: Newfoundland and Labrador is the most easterly point in North America and has its own time zone.
paras.zh: 紐芬蘭與拉布拉多（Newfoundland and Labrador）是北美洲最東端，有自己的時區。

paras.en: In addition to its natural beauty, the province has a unique heritage linked to the sea.
paras.zh: 除了自然美景，這個省還有與海洋相連的獨特傳承。

paras.en: The oldest colony of the British Empire and a strategic prize in Canada's early history, the province has long been known for its fisheries, coastal fishing villages and distinct culture.
paras.zh: 作為大英帝國最古老的殖民地、加拿大早期歷史中的戰略要地，這個省長期以來以漁業、沿海漁村和獨特的文化聞名。

paras.en: Today off-shore oil and gas extraction contributes a substantial part of the economy.
paras.zh: 今天，海上石油和天然氣開採占經濟相當大的一部分。

paras.en: Labrador also has immense hydro-electric resources.
paras.zh: 拉布拉多也有巨大的水力發電資源。

paras.en: Prince Edward Island (P.E.I.) is the smallest province, known for its beaches, red soil and agriculture, especially potatoes.
paras.zh: 愛德華王子島（Prince Edward Island，P.E.I.）是最小的省，以海灘、紅土和農業聞名，尤其是馬鈴薯。

paras.en: P.E.I. is the birthplace of Confederation, connected to mainland Canada by one of the longest continuous multispan bridges in the world, the Confederation Bridge.
paras.zh: 愛德華王子島是聯邦的誕生地，由世界上最長的連續多跨橋之一「聯邦大橋」與加拿大本土相連。

paras.en: Anne of Green Gables, set in P.E.I. by Lucy Maud Montgomery, is a much-loved story about the adventures of a little red-headed orphan girl.
paras.zh: 露西・莫德・蒙哥馬利（Lucy Maud Montgomery）以愛德華王子島為背景的《清秀佳人》（Anne of Green Gables），是一個深受喜愛的故事，講述一個紅髮小孤女的冒險。

paras.en: Nova Scotia is the most populous Atlantic Province, with a rich history as the gateway to Canada.
paras.zh: 新斯科細亞（Nova Scotia）是人口最多的大西洋省份，作為加拿大的門戶有豐富的歷史。

paras.en: Known for the world's highest tides in the Bay of Fundy, the province's identity is linked to shipbuilding, fisheries and shipping.
paras.zh: 以芬迪灣世界最高的潮汐聞名，這個省的身分與造船、漁業和航運息息相關。

paras.en: As Canada's largest east coast port, deep-water and ice-free, the capital, Halifax, has played an important role in Atlantic trade and defence and is home to Canada's largest naval base.
paras.zh: 首府哈利法克斯是加拿大東岸最大的港口，水深且終年不結冰，在大西洋貿易和國防上扮演重要角色，也是加拿大最大海軍基地的所在地。

paras.en: Nova Scotia has a long history of coal mining, forestry and agriculture.
paras.zh: 新斯科細亞有悠久的煤礦、林業和農業歷史。

paras.en: Today there is also off-shore oil and gas exploration.
paras.zh: 今天也有海上石油和天然氣的探勘。

paras.en: The province's Celtic and Gaelic traditions sustain a vibrant culture.
paras.zh: 這個省的凱爾特和蓋爾傳統維繫著充滿活力的文化。

paras.en: Nova Scotia is home to over 700 annual festivals, including the spectacular military tattoo in Halifax.
paras.zh: 新斯科細亞每年有超過 700 個節慶，包括哈利法克斯壯觀的軍樂表演。

paras.en: Situated in the Appalachian Range, New Brunswick was founded by the United Empire Loyalists and has the second largest river system on North America's Atlantic coastline, the St. John River system.
paras.zh: 位於阿帕拉契山脈的新布藍瑞克（New Brunswick），由聯合帝國效忠派建立，擁有北美大西洋沿岸第二大的河流系統——聖約翰河系統。

paras.en: Forestry, agriculture, fisheries, mining, food processing and tourism are the principal industries.
paras.zh: 林業、農業、漁業、礦業、食品加工和旅遊業是主要產業。

paras.en: Saint John is the largest city, port and manufacturing centre; Moncton is the principal Francophone Acadian centre; and Fredericton, the historic capital.
paras.zh: 聖約翰（Saint John）是最大的城市、港口和製造中心；蒙克頓（Moncton）是主要的法語阿卡迪亞中心；弗雷德里克頓（Fredericton）是歷史悠久的首府。

paras.en: New Brunswick is the only officially bilingual province, and about one-third of the population lives and works in French.
paras.zh: 新布藍瑞克是唯一官方雙語的省份，約三分之一的人口以法語生活和工作。

paras.en: The province's pioneer Loyalist and French cultural heritage and history come alive in street festivals and traditional music.
paras.zh: 這個省的效忠派拓荒者和法國文化遺產與歷史，在街頭節慶和傳統音樂中鮮活地呈現。

paras.en: More than half the people in Canada live in cities and towns near the Great Lakes and the St. Lawrence River in southern Quebec and Ontario, known as Central Canada and the industrial and manufacturing heartland.
paras.zh: 加拿大超過一半的人口住在魁北克南部和安大略五大湖與聖羅倫斯河附近的城鎮，這裡被稱為中部加拿大，是工業和製造業的心臟地帶。

paras.en: Southern Ontario and Quebec have cold winters and warm humid summers.
paras.zh: 安大略南部和魁北克冬天寒冷，夏天溫暖潮濕。

paras.en: Together, Ontario and Quebec produce more than three-quarters of all Canadian manufactured goods.
paras.zh: 安大略和魁北克合起來生產加拿大四分之三以上的製造品。

paras.en: Nearly eight million people live in Quebec, the vast majority along or near the St. Lawrence River.
paras.zh: 將近八百萬人住在魁北克（Quebec），絕大多數沿著或靠近聖羅倫斯河。

paras.en: More than three-quarters speak French as their first language.
paras.zh: 超過四分之三的人以法語為第一語言。

paras.en: The resources of the Canadian Shield have helped Quebec to develop important industries, including forestry, energy and mining.
paras.zh: 加拿大地盾的資源幫助魁北克發展了重要產業，包括林業、能源和礦業。

paras.en: Quebec is Canada's main producer of pulp and paper.
paras.zh: 魁北克是加拿大主要的紙漿和紙張生產地。

paras.en: The province's huge supply of fresh water has made it Canada's largest producer of hydro-electricity.
paras.zh: 這個省龐大的淡水資源使它成為加拿大最大的水力發電生產者。

paras.en: Quebecers are leaders in cutting-edge industries such as pharmaceuticals and aeronautics.
paras.zh: 魁北克人在製藥和航空等尖端產業居於領先地位。

paras.en: Quebec films, music, literary works and food have international stature, especially in La Francophonie, an association of French-speaking nations.
paras.zh: 魁北克的電影、音樂、文學作品和美食享有國際地位，尤其在法語國家組織（La Francophonie）中。

paras.en: Montreal, Canada's second largest city and the second largest mainly French-speaking city in the world after Paris, is famous for its cultural diversity.
paras.zh: 蒙特婁（Montreal）是加拿大第二大城市，也是世界上僅次於巴黎的第二大法語城市，以文化多元聞名。

paras.en: At more than 12 million, the people of Ontario make up more than one-third of Canadians.
paras.zh: 安大略（Ontario）人口超過一千兩百萬，占加拿大人口的三分之一以上。

paras.en: The large and culturally diverse population, natural resources and strategic location contribute to a vital economy.
paras.zh: 龐大而文化多元的人口、自然資源和戰略位置，造就了充滿活力的經濟。

paras.en: Toronto is the largest city in Canada and the country's main financial centre.
paras.zh: 多倫多（Toronto）是加拿大最大的城市，也是國家的主要金融中心。

paras.en: Many people work in the service or manufacturing industries, which produce a large percentage of Canada's exports.
paras.zh: 許多人在服務業或製造業工作，這些產業生產加拿大很大一部分的出口品。

paras.en: The Niagara region is known for its vineyards, wines and fruit crops.
paras.zh: 尼加拉地區以葡萄園、葡萄酒和水果作物聞名。

paras.en: Ontario farmers raise dairy and beef cattle, poultry, and vegetable and grain crops.
paras.zh: 安大略的農民飼養乳牛和肉牛、家禽，並種植蔬菜和穀物。

paras.en: Founded by United Empire Loyalists, Ontario also has the largest French-speaking population outside of Quebec, with a proud history of preserving their language and culture.
paras.zh: 由聯合帝國效忠派建立的安大略，也擁有魁北克以外最多的法語人口，他們以保存自己語言和文化的歷史為榮。

paras.en: There are five Great Lakes located between Ontario and the United States: Lake Ontario, Lake Erie, Lake Huron, Lake Michigan (in the U.S.A.) and Lake Superior, the largest freshwater lake in the world.
paras.zh: 安大略與美國之間有五大湖：安大略湖、伊利湖、休倫湖、密西根湖（在美國境內），以及世界最大的淡水湖蘇必略湖。

paras.en: Manitoba, Saskatchewan and Alberta are the Prairie Provinces, rich in energy resources and some of the most fertile farmland in the world.
paras.zh: 曼尼托巴、薩克其萬和亞伯達是草原省份，擁有豐富的能源資源和世界上最肥沃的農田之一。

paras.en: The region is mostly dry, with cold winters and hot summers.
paras.zh: 這個地區大多乾燥，冬天寒冷，夏天炎熱。

paras.en: Manitoba's economy is based on agriculture, mining and hydro-electric power generation.
paras.zh: 曼尼托巴（Manitoba）的經濟以農業、礦業和水力發電為基礎。

paras.en: The province's most populous city is Winnipeg, whose Exchange District includes the most famous street intersection in Canada, Portage and Main.
paras.zh: 這個省人口最多的城市是溫尼伯（Winnipeg），它的交易區包含加拿大最著名的十字路口——波蒂奇大道與緬街（Portage and Main）。

paras.en: Winnipeg's French Quarter, St. Boniface, has Western Canada's largest Francophone community at 45,000.
paras.zh: 溫尼伯的法語區聖博尼法斯（St. Boniface）擁有加拿大西部最大的法語社群，有四萬五千人。

paras.en: Manitoba is also an important centre of Ukrainian culture, with 14% reporting Ukrainian origins, and the largest Aboriginal population of any province, at over 15%.
paras.zh: 曼尼托巴也是烏克蘭文化的重要中心，14% 的人自報烏克蘭血統；它也是各省中原住民人口比例最高的，超過 15%。

paras.en: Saskatchewan, once known as the "breadbasket of the world" and the "wheat province," has 40% of the arable land in Canada and is the country's largest producer of grains and oilseeds.
paras.zh: 薩克其萬（Saskatchewan）曾被稱為「世界的麵包籃」和「小麥之省」，擁有加拿大 40% 的可耕地，是全國最大的穀物和油籽生產地。

paras.en: It also boasts the world's richest deposits of uranium and potash, used in fertilizer, and produces oil and natural gas.
paras.zh: 它還擁有世界上最豐富的鈾礦和鉀鹽礦藏（鉀鹽用於肥料），也生產石油和天然氣。

paras.en: Regina, the capital, is home to the training academy of the Royal Canadian Mounted Police.
paras.zh: 首府里賈納（Regina）是皇家加拿大騎警訓練學院的所在地。

paras.en: Saskatoon, the largest city, is the headquarters of the mining industry and an important educational, research and technology centre.
paras.zh: 最大的城市薩斯卡通（Saskatoon）是礦業的總部，也是重要的教育、研究和科技中心。

paras.en: Alberta is the most populous Prairie province.
paras.zh: 亞伯達（Alberta）是人口最多的草原省份。

paras.en: The province, and the world-famous Lake Louise in the Rocky Mountains, were both named after Princess Louise Caroline Alberta, fourth daughter of Queen Victoria.
paras.zh: 這個省和洛磯山脈中舉世聞名的露易絲湖，都是以維多利亞女王的第四個女兒露易絲・卡洛琳・亞伯達公主命名的。

paras.en: Alberta has five national parks, including Banff National Park, established in 1885.
paras.zh: 亞伯達有五個國家公園，包括 1885 年設立的班夫國家公園。

paras.en: The rugged Badlands house some of the world's richest deposits of prehistoric fossils and dinosaur finds.
paras.zh: 崎嶇的惡地藏有世界上最豐富的史前化石和恐龍發現。

paras.en: Alberta is the largest producer of oil and gas, and the oil sands in the north are being developed as a major energy source.
paras.zh: 亞伯達是最大的石油和天然氣生產地，北部的油砂正被開發為主要能源。

paras.en: Alberta is also renowned for agriculture, especially for the vast cattle ranches that make Canada one of the world's major beef producers.
paras.zh: 亞伯達也以農業聞名，尤其是廣大的牧牛場，使加拿大成為世界主要牛肉生產國之一。

paras.en: British Columbia is known for its majestic mountains and as Canada's Pacific gateway.
paras.zh: 卑詩省以雄偉的山脈聞名，也是加拿大通往太平洋的門戶。

paras.en: The Port of Vancouver, Canada's largest and busiest, handles billions of dollars in goods traded around the world.
paras.zh: 溫哥華港是加拿大最大、最繁忙的港口，處理價值數十億美元、與世界各地交易的貨物。

paras.en: Warm airstreams from the Pacific Ocean give the B.C. coast a temperate climate.
paras.zh: 來自太平洋的暖氣流讓卑詩省海岸有溫和的氣候。

paras.en: British Columbia (B.C.), on the Pacific coast, is Canada's westernmost province, with a population of four million.
paras.zh: 位於太平洋岸的卑詩省（British Columbia，B.C.）是加拿大最西邊的省，人口四百萬。

paras.en: The Port of Vancouver is our gateway to the Asia-Pacific.
paras.zh: 溫哥華港是我們通往亞太地區的門戶。

paras.en: About one-half of all the goods produced in B.C. are forestry products, including lumber, newsprint, and pulp and paper products—the most valuable forestry industry in Canada.
paras.zh: 卑詩省生產的商品約有一半是林產品，包括木材、新聞紙、紙漿和紙製品——是加拿大最有價值的林業。

paras.en: B.C. is also known for mining, fishing, and the fruit orchards and wine industry of the Okanagan Valley.
paras.zh: 卑詩省也以礦業、漁業，以及奧卡納根谷的果園和葡萄酒產業聞名。

paras.en: B.C. has the most extensive park system in Canada, with approximately 600 provincial parks.
paras.zh: 卑詩省擁有加拿大最龐大的公園系統，約有 600 個省立公園。

paras.en: The province's large Asian communities have made Chinese and Punjabi the most spoken languages in the cities after English.
paras.zh: 這個省龐大的亞裔社群，使中文和旁遮普語成為城市裡僅次於英語最常使用的語言。

paras.en: The capital, Victoria, is a tourist centre and headquarters of the navy's Pacific fleet.
paras.zh: 首府維多利亞（Victoria）是旅遊中心，也是海軍太平洋艦隊的總部。

paras.en: The Northwest Territories, Nunavut and Yukon contain one-third of Canada's land mass but have a population of only 100,000.
paras.zh: 西北地區、努納福特和育空占加拿大三分之一的陸地面積，但人口只有十萬。

paras.en: There are gold, lead, copper, diamond and zinc mines.
paras.zh: 這裡有金礦、鉛礦、銅礦、鑽石礦和鋅礦。

paras.en: Oil and gas deposits are being developed.
paras.zh: 石油和天然氣礦藏正在開發中。

paras.en: The North is often referred to as the "Land of the Midnight Sun" because at the height of summer, daylight can last up to 24 hours.
paras.zh: 北方常被稱為「午夜太陽之地」，因為在盛夏，白晝可長達 24 小時。

paras.en: In winter, the sun disappears and darkness sets in for three months.
paras.zh: 冬天，太陽消失，黑暗持續三個月。

paras.en: The Northern territories have long cold winters and short cool summers.
paras.zh: 北方地區冬天漫長寒冷，夏天短暫涼爽。

paras.en: Much of the North is made up of tundra, the vast rocky Arctic plain.
paras.zh: 北方大部分是凍原，也就是廣闊多岩石的北極平原。

paras.en: Because of the cold Arctic climate, there are no trees on the tundra and the soil is permanently frozen.
paras.zh: 由於北極的寒冷氣候，凍原上沒有樹木，土壤永久凍結。

paras.en: Some continue to earn a living by hunting, fishing and trapping.
paras.zh: 有些人仍靠狩獵、捕魚和設陷阱捕獸維生。

paras.en: Inuit art is sold throughout Canada and around the world.
paras.zh: 因紐特藝術品銷售到全加拿大和世界各地。

paras.en: The Northwest Territories (N.W.T.) were originally made up in 1870 from Rupert's Land and the North-Western Territory.
paras.zh: 西北地區（Northwest Territories，N.W.T.）最初在 1870 年由魯珀特地和西北領地組成。

paras.en: The capital, Yellowknife (population 20,000), is called the "diamond capital of North America."
paras.zh: 首府黃刀鎮（Yellowknife，人口兩萬）被稱為「北美鑽石之都」。

paras.en: More than half the population is Aboriginal (Dene, Inuit and Métis).
paras.zh: 超過一半的人口是原住民（迪尼族、因紐特人和梅蒂人）。

paras.en: The Mackenzie River, at 4,200 kilometres, is the second-longest river system in North America after the Mississippi and drains an area of 1.8 million square kilometres.
paras.zh: 馬更些河（Mackenzie River）長 4,200 公里，是北美僅次於密西西比河的第二長河流系統，流域面積 180 萬平方公里。

paras.en: Thousands of miners came to the Yukon during the Gold Rush of the 1890s, as celebrated in the poetry of Robert W. Service.
paras.zh: 1890 年代淘金熱期間，成千上萬的礦工來到育空（Yukon），詩人羅伯特・W・瑟維斯（Robert W. Service）的詩歌歌頌了這段歷史。

paras.en: Mining remains a significant part of the economy.
paras.zh: 礦業仍然是經濟的重要部分。

paras.en: The White Pass and Yukon Railway opened from Skagway in neighbouring Alaska to the territorial capital, Whitehorse, in 1900 and provides a spectacular tourist excursion across precipitous passes and bridges.
paras.zh: 白隘口與育空鐵路於 1900 年通車，從鄰近阿拉斯加的史凱威到地區首府白馬市（Whitehorse），提供穿越險峻山口和橋梁的壯觀觀光行程。

paras.en: Yukon holds the record for the coldest temperature ever recorded in Canada (-63°C).
paras.zh: 育空保有加拿大有記錄以來最低溫的紀錄（攝氏零下 63 度）。

paras.en: Mount Logan, located in the Yukon, is the highest mountain in Canada.
paras.zh: 位於育空的洛根山（Mount Logan）是加拿大最高的山。

paras.en: It is named in honour of Sir William Logan, a world-famous geologist, born in Montreal in 1798 to Scottish immigrant parents, who founded and directed the Geological Survey of Canada from 1842 to 1869 and is considered one of Canada's greatest scientists.
paras.zh: 它以世界著名地質學家威廉・洛根爵士（Sir William Logan）命名；他 1798 年生於蒙特婁，父母是蘇格蘭移民，1842 年到 1869 年創立並領導加拿大地質調查局，被視為加拿大最偉大的科學家之一。

paras.en: Nunavut, meaning "our land" in Inuktitut, was established in 1999 from the eastern part of the Northwest Territories, including all of the former District of Keewatin.
paras.zh: 努納福特（Nunavut）在因紐特語中意為「我們的土地」，於 1999 年從西北地區的東部設立，包括原來的整個基瓦丁區。

paras.en: The capital is Iqaluit, formerly Frobisher Bay, named after the English explorer Martin Frobisher, who penetrated the uncharted Arctic for Queen Elizabeth I in 1576.
paras.zh: 首府是伊魁特（Iqaluit），舊稱弗羅比舍灣，以英國探險家馬丁・弗羅比舍命名；他在 1576 年為伊莉莎白一世女王深入未知的北極。

paras.en: The 19-member Legislative Assembly chooses a premier and ministers by consensus.
paras.zh: 由 19 名議員組成的立法議會以共識方式選出省長和部長。

paras.en: The population is about 85% Inuit, and Inuktitut is an official language and the first language in schools.
paras.zh: 人口約 85% 是因紐特人，因紐特語是官方語言，也是學校的第一語言。

paras.en: Canada's vast North brings security and sovereignty challenges.
paras.zh: 加拿大廣闊的北方帶來安全與主權的挑戰。

paras.en: Dealing with harsh weather conditions in an isolated region, the Canadian Rangers, part of the Canadian Forces Reserves (militia), play a key role.
paras.zh: 在偏遠地區面對嚴酷天氣，加拿大巡邏隊（Canadian Rangers）——加拿大軍隊後備部隊（民兵）的一部分——扮演關鍵角色。

paras.en: Drawing on indigenous knowledge and experience, the Rangers travel by snowmobile in the winter and all-terrain vehicles in the summer from Resolute to the Magnetic North Pole, and keep the flag flying in Canada's Arctic.
paras.zh: 巡邏隊運用原住民的知識和經驗，冬天騎雪上摩托車、夏天駕駛全地形車，從雷索盧特一直巡邏到磁北極，讓國旗在加拿大的北極飄揚。
